name: Omega
overview: The title 'Omega,' paired with 'Alpha,' reveals the all-encompassing nature of Christ as the eternal God who is the beginning and the end of all things. In Revelation 1:8 and 22:13, Christ declares Himself the Alpha and Omega, affirming His eternal existence and sovereign authority over time and history. This comprehensive identity is further emphasized in Revelation 21:6 and 1:11, where He is both the first and the last, commissioning the faithful and offering the living water freely to those who thirst, underscoring His role as the source and fulfillment of spiritual life.
